title: Quick-fix Venezuelan Pickle Stir-Fry
description: A quick and diabetic-friendly stir-fry dish featuring crispy vegetables and tangy pickles from Venezuela. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 small onion, 2 cloves of garlic, and 1 small jalapeño pepper to the skillet. Cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add 1 medium zucchini and 2 medium Yukon gold potatoes to the skillet. Cook for 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add 1 cup of Venezuelan pickles to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Season with 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, and 2 tablespoons of granulated sugar (if using).
Stir in 1/4 cup of chopped cilantro. Cook for 1 minute, or until the cilantro is wilted.
Divide 2 cups of cooked rice onto plates. Top with the stir-fry mixture.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
